Stop! Pisces, the cosmic scales are tipping dangerously on your finances, your love life, and your soul today.

The Sun in Libra is forming a hard opposition to Saturn in your 2nd House of Resources, while Venus conjuncts your Sun in the 8th House of Shared Wealth. Your modern ruler Neptune sits with Saturn, and your deep Water element is absorbing this intense pressure right now.

Singles might meet a serious partner at work, but taken Pisces must avoid money fights during dinner dates to keep trust truly intact with your partner tonight.

Jupiter in Capricorn sits powerfully in your 11th House of Networks, so push that bold promotion request now while the energy stays this way.

Warning: Do not sign contracts until Friday, or you will very deeply regret the fine print completely.
